race.comment: NOSIE BY NATURE (2) brings the strongest recent line after closing from well back for third in a BM60 at Murray Bdge, beaten two and a half lengths while near the top of an open market. He is second-up, proven at 1200m and represents a stable with a strong record at this track. Looks the one to beat. ICE SYMPHONY (1) has not been finishing off, but both runs this campaign were in BM64 grade and his latest ninth came after racing wide throughout at this track. His track-and-trip win and third-up set-up make him the main danger. VOLKANO (6) resumes with a Murray Bdge trial win behind him and his neck second to NOSIE BY NATURE at Mildura is a strong reference, though his final run before the spell was plain. I'M KENNY (8) rises sharply from picnic grade but arrives in form after a narrow Wentworth second and a Jamestown win, with the 4kg claim keeping him as a place hope. Include in wider plays.
